newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile condemns Blanco killing, sends condolences.
newsitem.headline: Chile condemns Blanco killing, sends condolences.

text.p: Chilean President Eduardo Frei on Monday condemned the killing of a young Spanish politician by Basque separatists and sent Chile's condolences to Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar.

"At this time of so much pain and sorrow for the brother Spanish people, we reiterate our energetic rejection of the use of violence as a political weapon," Frei said in a statement issued by his office.
Miguel Angel Blanco, a popular 29-year-old town councillor, was kidnapped and killed by Basque guerrillas over the weekend.

Frei's statement said Chile "condemns in the most energetic way those who try to use terror to impose their aims, and reiterates that democracy and respect for human rights are the guiding principles of all political activity."
